title: Fix Settings Panel in Sketchpad Across All Apps
description: Fix the settings panel in the sketchpad across all apps. The screenshot shows settings rows with broken/garbled display for diagram settings (lineStyle, distance, cornerRadius, centerString) and general settings (theme, language, device, expertise, mode). Need to investigate and fix the rendering issues.
summary: Fixed settings panel in sketchpad across all apps by resolving 4 duplicate JSON keys in English translation bundles (elements/ui/index.tsx). Duplicate 'settings' keys in home and kit app translations caused JSON.parse to overwrite full settings objects (theme, language, device, expertise, mode, diagram) with label-only stubs, making useLabel return raw key paths instead of translated labels. Removed duplicate settings/chat entries for home and kit, removed duplicate quality.title entry, updated kit settings label from 'Kit Editor' to 'Settings', added missing 'device' translations for home settings in both DE/EN, and added complete docs settings translations (theme, language, device, expertise, mode) in both DE/EN. All 134 vitest tests pass, no TypeScript errors.
